# Bitwise Operators

void main() {
  a & b;
  a | b;
  a ^ b;
  ~a;
  a << b;
  a >> b;
  a >>> b;
}

==>

Program(Declaration(FunctionDeclaration(Type(TypeNoQuestion("void")),Identifier,"(",ParameterList,")",Block("{",Statement(ExpressionStatement(BinaryExpression(Identifier,"&",Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(BinaryExpression(Identifier,"|",Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(BinaryExpression(Identifier,"^",Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(UnaryExpression("~",Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(BinaryExpression(Identifier,ShiftOp,Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(BinaryExpression(Identifier,ShiftOp,Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(BinaryExpression(Identifier,ShiftOp,Identifier),";")),"}"))))

# Compound Assignment

void main() {
  a += b;
  a -= b;
  a *= b;
  a /= b;
  a %= b;
  a ~/= b;
  a <<= b;
  a &= b;
  a |= b;
  a ^= b;
}

==>

Program(Declaration(FunctionDeclaration(Type(TypeNoQuestion("void")),Identifier,"(",ParameterList,")",Block("{",Statement(ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier)),CompoundAssign,Identifier),";")),"}"))))

# Precedence

void main() {
  a + b * c;
  a | b & c;
  a || b && c;
}

==>

Program(Declaration(FunctionDeclaration(Type(TypeNoQuestion("void")),Identifier,"(",ParameterList,")",Block("{",Statement(ExpressionStatement(BinaryExpression(Identifier,"+",BinaryExpression(Identifier,"*",Identifier)),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(BinaryExpression(Identifier,"|",BinaryExpression(Identifier,"&",Identifier)),";")),Statement(ExpressionStatement(BinaryExpression(Identifier,"||",BinaryExpression(Identifier,"&&",Identifier)),";")),"}"))))
